decisions.reason: Retain. Leon explains the Midway workshop's location-specific repair limits and intermittent specialist availability before the customer transports a trailer. The guide asks which services are available at a genuine business location, rejects converting service reach into an office claim, and assigns maintenance of changing coverage and booking conditions. It therefore supports the current label and the record's explicit Midway/Gadsden versus Tallahassee/Leon distinction.
